rules: The <type> is the verb of the subject: "<type> <description>" has to read as one sentence, with the description completing the type. Keep it imperative ("add", never "added")

Never open the description with a second verb. "fix stop the footer from wrapping" stacks two sentences; "fix the footer wrapping" is one. Drop the verb and keep what it acted on, or move it into the sentence the type opens

Pick the gitmoji from the official list, and pick the type from the types above. They are independent choices: never derive the type from the gitmoji's name or description. When no type obviously fits, collapse to the nearest general one
Never sign a commit as an agent: no Co-Authored-By for the agent, no "Generated with" line, no robot-emoji attribution. A human co-author is welcome, an agent is not

forbiddenFooters.label: an agent credited as co-author, named with no surname
a Co-Authored-By footer pointing at an agent's domain
